reviewRemediation.deadlineRecovery: Terminal transitions enqueue deterministic FINALIZE_VERIFICATION jobs. Parsing and evidence persistence run after state commit; malformed/missing definitions fail only the evidence job with safe error codes. Cancellation and repeated/concurrent recovery retain terminal state and one incident event.
reviewRemediation.outputContract: Shared 10 MiB decoded cap; marker bytes included; re-bound after sanitization with gzip headroom. Artifact upload errors persist a bounded sanitized explanation and never suppress execution-result submission; transient interrupted deliveries recover from the spool. Results have a bounded 1 MiB request allowance for JSON escaping of the maximum valid preview/error/evidence schema. Metadata fsync failures cannot block already-durable outcomes; successful artifact retries remove obsolete failure notices.
reviewRemediation.evidenceProtection: Signed pre/post-state evidence sanitized independently at server persistence; UTF-8 previews remain inside the byte budget.
reviewRemediation.claimLatency: Disable JIT compilation only in the short Agent claim transaction. The 10,000-ineligible-write backlog regression passes with the original 2-second statement timeout and 1-second lock timeout.
reviewRemediation.browserAssertions: Scope signing error to main and SSO revocation confirmation to the authentication component, preserving inline feedback and toast. Signing-key case initializes its real setup prerequisite and supports isolated execution. Configurable validated RUNBOOK_UI_PORT prevents concurrent fixture conflicts.

verificationRevisionFollowUp.implementation: Add verificationRevision (default zero) and increment it atomically with each successful terminal transition. Each revision owns a new durable job. Obsolete workers skip before parsing or updating evidence; parent row locks serialize proof with late-result recovery. Clear stale proof on accepted late evidence. Terminal late failures also enqueue fresh proof; duplicate deliveries do not.
verificationRevisionFollowUp.compatibility: Additive migration; existing unversioned verification payloads remain supported. No existing processing/completed job is reset or overwritten.
verificationRevisionFollowUp.regressions: Real PostgreSQL FAILED → RUNNING → SUCCEEDED with authored Agent verification, both COMPLETED and PROCESSING prior jobs, true final evidence, unchanged old jobs, ignored old workers, no duplicate physical attempt, and repeated reconciliation; terminal late failure and duplicate result delivery.
verificationRevisionFollowUp.qualification: Beta hardening only; no new HA, sustained active workload or production distribution certification claimed.
